intro.text: A kandra who spent sixteen months posing as the dead constable Cassileux, keeping watch on Marasi from inside the Elendel constabulary.

items.text: LeeMar took Cassileux's place after the constable died in a raid on the Nomad Gang, one of several kandra hidden among the constables. She kept an eye on Marasi, sometimes lunching with her. While the constables searched the caverns below Elendel, she quietly took a note Moonlight had left for Marasi on the Ghostbloods' behalf and passed it to VenDell, who then told Marasi what Cassileux really was.
